text:
Maria (Design): quick design pass on the routing policies editor priority surface — swapped the stacking in the mock. worried the compact rows lose hierarchy when multiple rules are collapsed. TL;DR: stronger reorder affordance + clearer validation states needed. Dan (Product): nice, can you share the mock? is this for the compact mode or the full canvas? dMaria (Design): compact mode first, but affects canvas too. attaching two screenshots in the thread. main issues: reorder handle blends into token pills, validation toast is too global (looks like a system error), and the preview sim playback doesn't show which rule matched. Alex (Eng): agree on the preview — dev side we only surface match id atm. showing the matching rule name in the sim would help. cheap fix: include a highlight overlay during sim playback. Sam (Frontend): can we annotate the reorder handle with an accessible label? e.g., show a 16px grab icon that appears on hover and always render a 1px darker border in compact mode. Lia (Accessibility): +1 for visible grab affordance. also keyboard nav needs an explicit order announcement for SRs when rules are re-sequenced. current aria-live anncs are too terse. Maria (Design): sample copy for validation inline: "This rule is invalid: overlapping condition with rule 'Allow - billing' — fix or reorder." would that be too noisy? Dan (Product): that copy is clear. prefer inline contextual copy rather than a global toast. therapists (typo) -> sorry, meant this is higher priority than leftover microcopy tweaks. Alex (Eng): implementation notes: adding highlight overlay is straightforward. for inline validation we can attach an error badge to the rule row and open a small popover with details on click. SR announcement could be "Rule X: invalid — overlaps with rule Y". Sam (Frontend): prototyping suggestion: show a faint left accent (4px) on the active/highlighted rule during preview, and animate it for 300ms so attention is obvious without being jarring. CSS prototype: ```css .rule-row--preview { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var(--accent); transition: box-shadow 300ms ease; } ``` Lia (Accessibility): contrast check: accent #2F80ED on white has AA fail at small text. prefer #005EC7 for 4.5:1. if we need a lighter color for branding, use it only for decorative accents and rely on a thicker border or different pattern for functional states. Maria (Design): noted — will update mock to #005EC7 and add the left accent. also trying two reorder affordances: a visible grab handle + a denser hit target area for touch. Sam (Frontend): for screen-reader we should have `aria-roledescription=\"rule\"` and an `aria-live=\"polite\"` region for order changes. minimal snippet: ```html
Rule \"Allow - billing\" moved to position 2
``` Lia (Accessibility): better to use `role=\"status\"` combined with `aria-atomic=\"true\"` and ensure the copy is full sentence: "Rule 'Allow - billing' was moved to position two." avoids clipped phrasing. Alex (Eng): small technical concern: continuous sim playback + animated highlight might cause perf on low-end devices. Sam, can we limit to 1 frame per second for the animated accent during sim? Sam (Frontend): yep, can throttle animations during sim or fallback to a static highlight if device reports low FPS. Maria (Design): copy tweaks: propose rule row action label be "Reorder" (instead of just icon tooltip) in keyboard-only mode. and validation button copy: "See conflict" -> "Show conflict details". thoughts? Dan (Product): sounds good. prioritize "Show conflict details" change — it's clearer for users in support tickets. Alex (Eng): will take the highlight + inline badge work in the sprint. can someone file a small GH issue with the copy and accessibility updates so we track it? Maria (Design): filing now. (links to PR template) @design-bot creating issue: "priority-surface: visual hierarchy & validation UX for compact rules". design-bot: Issue created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-ui/issues/3421 :eyes: Lia (Accessibility): one more ask: keyboard focus styles must meet 3:1 contrast and be 3px thick minimum for touch targets. Sam (Frontend): noted. I'll open a WIP PR with CSS and aria snippet by EOD. Maria (Design): thanks team — will post updated mock with the #005EC7 accent and the copy changes. can we review tomorrow morning before planning? :thumbsup: Dan (Product): yes, schedule 9am sync. thanks!
